messages:
Maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: promotions/comp timeline. I'll jot action items here and answer rapid questions.
Sara (Eng Manager): thanks! is the promotion effective date the review cutoff or the approval date?
Maria (People Ops): Effective date = review cycle cutoff (Mar 31) for title/promos, salary changes go into the next payroll cycle (usually first pay period after approvals). Retro pay: yes, for salary increases approved during this cycle we do retro to 3/31 on the first paycheck after HR completes changes.
Jamal (SWE): if someone moves IC -> EM in the same cycle, do they get both level change and manager comp? any special approvals?
Kevin (People Ops): good q. IC->EM needs both calibration + people-ops sign-off. EM comp is on a separate manager band approval flow. Please flag those hires in the calibration doc so we can route for approval.
Sara (Eng Manager): got it. where's the calibration doc? can't find it in the all-hands slides link.
Maria (People Ops): Link: https://redwoodinc.slack.com/archives/people-ops/promo-calib-2026 (also pinned in #people-ops). Quick snippet from the manager checklist:
```
Manager checklist for promo cycle:
- Review guidance + example writeups
- Add recommendations to calibration doc by 04/07 EOD
- Attend calibration meeting 04/09 (block on calendar)
- Complete salary approval form for any comp > band midpoint
```
Jamal (SWE): timeline question: when do we expect final messages to people?
Maria (People Ops): Managers will get final outcomes by 04/14, rollouts to individuals start 04/15–04/17 depending on manager availability. If you need exceptions (e.g., regulatory or external offer), DM me asap.
AJ (CTO): one more ask from leadership: please include a 1–2 sentence justification (impact + signal) for each promotion recommendation in the doc. helps speed calibration.
Sara (Eng Manager): can we mark items "high-priority - external offer" so UX for rolling out is quicker?
Kevin (People Ops): yes — add tag `external-offer` in the right-most column. we'll triage those first.
Maria (People Ops): last note: comp pool is modestly increased this cycle but still constrained. Expect some tough calls on leveling vs. comp. Reach out to Kevin or me if you want to run scenarios. :handshake: 
Allhands-bot: Reminder: calibration meeting invite sent to attendees for 04/09 10:00–11:30 PT.
Sara (Eng Manager): thanks — will upload my team's recs today.
Jamal (SWE): thanks folks!
Maria (People Ops): appreciation — we'll keep this thread updated if any timeline shifts.
